messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 21):
"""
7.4 Any recapture provisions shall be described. 7.5 Reinsurance rates provided 7.6 Whether a copy of the reinsurance program and a copy of the Treaty is submitted to the IRDAI. Yes/No 7.6.1 Whether reinsurance program and a copy of the treaty enclosed (required only if these are not filed with the PMC previously) Yes/No 7.6.2 Whether the reinsurance proposed for the product is in line with the Board approved reinsurance program filed with thePMC Yes / No 7.6.3 If no, furnish the particulars Section VIII: Pricing 8 Premium Loadings & Discounts (Please provide objective and transparent criteria to offer discounts/rebate/Loadings And complete financial justifications by AA to every item referred hereunder. In case of General and Health Insurers to be also furnished separately in the Technical Note) 8.1 Sum insured rebates/discounts offered, if any
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
